description: This file defines the StoreBackend interface, specifying methods for verifying transactions via signatures or passwords, and enrolling public keys associated with user IDs within a server-side authentication system.

classes.name: StoreBackend
classes.description: Interface for backend storage and verification operations related to user transactions and public key enrollment.

methods.name: verify (Transaction, byte[])
methods.description: Verifies the transaction signature using the user's public key.

methods.name: verify (Transaction, String)
methods.description: Verifies the transaction using a password.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a public key for a user identified by userId and password.
